Hosts Anna Maria and Brian Clement welcome Dr. Mark Darrow to explore musculoskeletal health, fascia, prolotherapy, stem cells, and platelet-rich plasma. The episode critiques conventional high‑tech medicine, explains how targeted regenerative treatments can restore joints and soft tissue, and warns against unnecessary surgery and overreliance on imaging.

Dr. Darrow also emphasizes lifestyle and spirit — anti‑inflammatory diet, meditation, and attitude — as essential parts of healing, offering practical insights for anyone seeking alternatives to standard care.
